run_rl_training: run the main training loop for bisim baseline or deepmdp agents on DMC or CARLA environments
evaluate_agent: evaluate an RL agent over multiple episodes and log episode rewards and CARLA metrics
make_agent: create a BaselineAgent BisimAgent or DeepMDPAgent with configurable encoder decoder and SAC hyperparameters
collect_data: collect rollout trajectories from an agent and save observations actions and rewards to a MATLAB file
parse_args: parse command line arguments for environment agent training encoder decoder and evaluation configuration
